Numel

Fire Ground

Hoenn · Generation 3

Numel is a Fire/Ground-type Numb Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 24 kg. It evolves into Camerupt. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (65), with a base stat total of 305.
